```scratch
when green flag clicked
forever
  if <key [right arrow] pressed?> then
    change x by (10)
  end
  if <key [left arrow] pressed?> then
    change x by (-10)
  end
end
```

Now make the Fish fall:

```scratch
when green flag clicked
forever
  go to x: (pick random (-220) to (220)) y: (180)
  repeat until <touching [Cat v]?>
    change y by (-5)
  end
end
```

Now add a score:

1. Make a variable called `Score`.
2. Put this on the Fish:

```scratch
when green flag clicked
set [Score v] to (0)
forever
  go to x: (pick random (-220) to (220)) y: (180)
  repeat until <touching [Cat v]?>
    change y by (-5)
  end
  change [Score v] by (1)
end
```
